end.summary: Reyansh practised top, front and side views of solids and objects.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying how cubes, cylinders, cones, cups, caps and a ground view look from different places. Reyansh correctly described several views and used the idea of only drawing what is visible; they later corrected the mix-up that another person would see the same handle or sticker view. At home, ask Reyansh to sketch one object from the top, front and side, showing only the visible parts.
